name: Rumors for Kravel
summary: At last, Krazek has a letter about Nazz Steamboil for you to carry to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats. Keep its origin secret.

sections.title: A Letter From Krazek
sections.body: Krazek spent favors, a rare bottle of elven wine, and hours of deducing to learn about Nazz Steamboil. His letter holds very interesting bits about the goblin racer pilot. Krazek considers the letter too dangerous to use and leaves it to you, provided nobody learns where it came from. Carry it to Kravel Koalbeard on the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Kravel's Verdict
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard finds the letter very interesting. He wonders if he should bow to the goblin pilot the next time they meet. He expects Nazz Steamboil to pay a small fortune to keep the secret buried.

aliases: where do i get the rumors
faq.answer: Krazek gives you the letter in Booty Bay after you bring him the dream dust.

faq.q: To whom should the letter be brought?
aliases: where to turn in rumors for kravel
faq.answer: Bring the letter to Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Who is the subject of Krazek's findings?
faq.answer: Krazek's findings concern Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot. His letter holds very interesting bits about Nazz.

faq.q: How did Krazek uncover the information?
aliases: how did krazek get the info
faq.answer: Krazek spent favors, hours deducing, and a rare bottle of elven wine to uncover the information.

aliases: next quest after rumors for kravel
faq.answer: Next, you return to Booty Bay.
